purpose: find known-vulnerable and license-problematic third-party components in what is actually shipped
entry_criteria: Lockfiles are committed and the build is reproducible
Advisory data source and its refresh date are recorded
Policy for allowed severities and licenses exists
inputs: SBOM or tool to generate one
procedure: Generate an SBOM from resolved direct and transitive dependencies of the built artifact.
Match components to advisories; record advisory ids, affected range and fixed version.
Assess reachability and exploitability for each match; do not rate by CVSS alone.
Upgrade, replace or pin to a patched version; where none exists record a compensating control and an expiry.
Rebuild, regenerate the SBOM and compare against the earlier one to confirm the fix and spot new components.
Attach the SBOM and the disposition table to the release evidence.
acceptance_criteria: SBOM matches the shipped artifact, not only the manifest
No unresolved critical or high advisory without an approved exception
Every exception has owner and expiry
validation_method: Compare SBOM of the packaged artifact with the lockfile and re-run the audit after fixes.

validation.command: osv-scanner --lockfile=package-lock.json --format json > reports/sca.json   # example; use the ecosystem's audit tool
validation.expect: exit 0 or only findings listed in the exception register

validation.command: syft packages dir:. -o cyclonedx-json > reports/sbom.json   # example
validation.expect: component count matches the artifact contents

failure_modes.mode: Scan ran on the manifest, not the artifact
failure_modes.detection: SBOM lacks transitive or vendored components
Advisory snapshot older than the agreed age

failure_modes.response: Revert, pin, record a compensating control and a dated follow-up

worked_example: ILLUSTRATIVE: The audit reports a deserialization flaw in a transitive library. It is reachable because the service parses uploaded archives. The direct dependency is bumped to a release that pulls the patched version; the post-fix SBOM shows the new version and tests pass.
